parsed.name: 封膜机后端控制组件
parsed.description: 这是一个非实体的软件控制组件，用于定义实验室封膜机的基础控制接口，包括封膜、温度设置与温度读取，供上层实验流程或具体硬件实现调用。
parsed.description_en: This is a non-physical software control component that defines the basic control interface for a laboratory sealer, including sealing, temperature setting, and temperature readback, for use by higher-level workflows or concrete hardware implementations.

actions.description: 按给定温度和持续时间执行一次封膜操作。
actions.description_en: Execute one sealing operation using the specified temperature and duration.
